# pangolin_redirects (Data Source)

Retrieves the list of redirects for the organization, optionally filtered. All filters that are set must match.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List all redirects.
data "pangolin_redirects" "all" {}

# Only the enabled redirects attached to a given domain. domain_id is the
# Pangolin domain id (for example "domain2"), not the domain name.
data "pangolin_domains" "all" {}

data "pangolin_redirects" "by_domain" {
  domain_id = one([for d in data.pangolin_domains.all.domains : d.domain_id if d.base_domain == "example.com"])
  enabled   = true
}

output "redirect_names" {
  value = [for r in data.pangolin_redirects.all.redirects : r.name]
}

output "domain_redirect_destinations" {
  value = {
    for r in data.pangolin_redirects.by_domain.redirects : r.nice_id => r.destination_host
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `domain_id` (String) Only return redirects attached to this domain ID.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Only return redirects whose enabled state matches.
- `resource_id` (Number) Only return redirects attached to this HTTP resource ID.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier of the data source.
- `redirects` (Attributes List) List of redirects. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--redirects))

<a id="nestedatt--redirects"></a>
### Nested Schema for `redirects`

Read-Only:

- `base_domain` (String) The base domain of the attached domain. Null when attached to a resource.
- `destination_host` (String) The redirect target as `scheme://host[:port]`, with no path, query or fragment.
- `domain_id` (String) The ID of the domain this redirect is attached to. Null when attached to a resource.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the redirect is enabled.
- `id` (String) The numeric ID of the redirect.
- `match_path` (String) The request path to match. Null when unset.
- `name` (String) The name of the redirect.
- `nice_id` (String) The human-readable ID.
- `path_match_type` (String) How `match_path` is matched: `exact`, `prefix` or `regex`.
- `permanent` (Boolean) Whether the redirect is permanent: `true` answers with HTTP 308, `false` with HTTP 307.
- `priority` (Number) The match priority, from 1 to 1000. Reported as 100 when the server returns none.
- `resource_full_domain` (String) The full domain of the attached resource. Null when attached to a domain.
- `resource_id` (Number) The ID of the HTTP resource this redirect is attached to. Null when attached to a domain.
- `resource_name` (String) The name of the attached resource. Null when attached to a domain.
- `resource_nice_id` (String) The nice ID of the attached resource. Null when attached to a domain.
- `rewrite_path` (String) The replacement path appended to `destination_host`. Null when unset.
- `rewrite_path_type` (String) How the path is rewritten: `exact`, `prefix`, `regex` or `stripPrefix`. Null when unset.
- `ssl` (Boolean) Whether TLS is enabled for a domain-attached redirect.
- `subdomain` (String) The subdomain to redirect, combined with `domain_id`. Null when unset.
